faq.q: Is it safe to pay upfront?
faq.a: Yes. We use Stripe (same as Shopify, Amazon). Your money is held until we confirm purchase. If we can't get the figure, Stripe auto-refunds to your card in 5-10 business days.

faq.q: How long until the figure arrives?
faq.a: Depends on Japan availability. Usually 2-3 weeks from payment: 1-2 weeks to buy and receive in Spain + 1 week to ship to you. We notify at every step.

faq.q: What if the figure arrives damaged or wrong?
faq.a: 14-day returns (return shipping on us if our error). We inspect before shipping and send photos. If damaged in transit, mail insurance covers up to €500.

faq.q: Can I request figures not in catalog?
faq.a: Absolutely! Use the 'Request Figure' form. We search our suppliers and if found, notify you with price and photos. You get priority to reserve before it goes to catalog.
Yes. We only buy from official Japanese stores and retailers. Never from shady second-hand markets. Every figure comes with original box, authenticity holograms, and complete accessories.
